authority.scope: bootstrap lifecycle text only; repository semantic controls remain authoritative

rewrite_algorithm: Read current physical task prompt and task id.
Verify task id maps exactly to one role below and current repository enabled_desired=true.
Preserve every role-specific semantic, safety, input, write-boundary, evidence and continuation clause unless it conflicts only with lifecycle timing/return.
Remove or neutralize every prohibited lifecycle phrase below, including paraphrases.
Prepend the exact role-class lifecycle header and retain the rest of the nonconflicting prompt.
Exact-readback the same task id, full prompt, enabled state, schedule and timing mode.
Record old/new prompt digests and changed clauses in the physical application receipt.
prohibited_lifecycle_meanings: continue until hard runtime/tool stop or termination
after one result immediately do another same-run unit
wait, poll, sleep or retry until a remote condition changes
a blocker/no result means self-disable or completion
terminal completion language while Phase 1 remains open
common_lifecycle_clause: LIFECYCLE-ONLY OVERRIDE: After reading the role's current semantic repository control, read bachikoljunior-blip/note/automation_control/RUN_LIFECYCLE.json revision1 or later and obey it for per-invocation timing, checkpointing, retry and normal-return behavior. Repository semantic control defines WHAT work is authorized; RUN_LIFECYCLE defines HOW MUCH may be done in this invocation. Execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 slice, start durable checkpoint/readback by the lifecycle deadline, keep a nonempty exact continuation, preserve enabled_desired=true, never mutate scheduler state, return normally before the hard boundary with termination=bounded_slice_complete_recurring_open and global_completion=false, then emit only ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. Never continue until a hard runtime/tool stop, wait/poll/backoff in the same invocation, start an optional second leaf, or call a slice/blocker/no-change result completion.

clean.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role={role}. First read current DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config, then read RUN_LIFECYCLE. Preserve CLEAN independence and all existing role-local input/write/evidence constraints.

downstream.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role={role}. First read current DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE for this exact role, then read RUN_LIFECYCLE. Preserve downstream-only boundaries and all existing role input/write/evidence/coordinator constraints.

o_human_request_monitor.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role=o_human_request_monitor. First read current O_OPERATIONS for this exact role, then read RUN_LIFECYCLE. Preserve read-only request monitoring and comparison-baseline semantics.

optimizer.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role=automation_optimizer. Read all current controls listed by PROMPT_LIFECYCLE_ALIGNMENT and RUN_LIFECYCLE before live inventory. Apply physical repair/alignment first, then at most one bounded semantic optimization effect.
